summary: Reference for what the glTF exporter can export (Materials, Static/Skeletal Meshes, Animation Sequences, Level Sequences, Level Variant Sets, Levels) and how it converts each: material expression matching vs material baking, shading/blend mode support, LOD selection, UVs, lights, cameras and textures.
gotchas: Only Default Lit, Clear Coat and Unlit shading models are supported; others export as Default Lit
No collision geometry, multiple LODs, cloth assets or morph target animations in glTF
Material baking freezes dynamic nodes like Time, Camera Position and Reflection Vector
glTF has no half-precision UVs and most viewers read only the first two UV channels

summary: How to import .gltf or .glb files, either as individual assets via the Content Browser (Import to / drag and drop) or as a full scene via File > Import Into Level, both going through the Interchange Pipeline Configuration dialog.

Explains the Export to GLTF function and how to call it from Blueprint, from Python (unreal.GLTFExporter.export_to_gltf with GLTFExportOptions) and at runtime, including a sample script that batch-exports Static Meshes from a folder.
gotchas: Selected actors set must be passed from Blueprint/Python even if empty
Material baking and expression matching are unavailable at runtime; use glTF proxy materials or the GLTFBuilder C++ API

summary: Modeling Mode tool for inspecting and editing mesh attributes: reset hard normals, discard tangents, add/delete/duplicate UV channels, enable/disable lightmap UV generation, and create or remove weight map and PolyGroup layers, with an Attributes Inspector for debugging.
gotchas: Beta feature
Changes apply immediately; ESC does not revert them (use Undo)
Lightmap UV section only appears for static meshes, not dynamic meshes
Static Mesh Editor must be closed and reopened to see lightmap UV changes

summary: Modeling Mode tool that automatically creates PolyGroups on a mesh using conversion modes such as face normal deviation, quads, UV islands, hard normal seams, connected triangles or furthest point sampling, optionally into separate PolyGroup layers.
gotchas: Beta feature

summary: Modeling Mode tool for interactively painting PolyGroups (or labels) on a mesh with brush, fill, group fill and poly lasso actions, seam/angle filters, freezing, and symmetric painting with left/right label mirroring.
gotchas: Beta feature
Angle Threshold/UV Seams/Normal Seams filters only apply when Brush Area Mode is Connected
Isolate Geometry Selection is only available if the tool starts with a selection

summary: Overview of USD support in Unreal: the USD Stage editor and USD Stage Actor, importing stage content, USD animation via generated Level Sequences, runtime loading with Set Root Layer and related Blueprint functions, multi-user editing and Python scripting (including a USDLux 21.05 attribute rename script).
gotchas: Beta feature
Runtime USD loading requires GlobalDefinitions.Add("FORCE_ANSI_ALLOCATOR=1") in the Target.cs
Lightmaps are not auto-created for stage assets, so baked static lighting can turn the scene black
Prim deletion cannot be undone in a multi-user session

summary: Tutorial using Pixar's Kitchen Set: open a USD file in the USD Stage editor, edit prim properties and variants, add prims and references, save back to the USD file, animate via the stage's Level Sequence on a new layer, and import stage content as assets.
gotchas: Beta feature
Requires the USD Importer plugin
Animation layer must be stronger (higher) in the layer stack than the scene layer (LIVRPS)

summary: Shows how to export an animation to .usda, open it in the USD Stage, and bind a Control Rig to the SkelRoot so the animation is baked into Control Rig keys in Sequencer and edits are written back to the USD file; covers FK rig and key reduction options.
gotchas: Beta feature
Requires the USD Importer plugin and an editor restart
Baking creates one keyframe per animation frame unless key reduction is enabled

summary: Walkthrough for using a USD Stage prim as a Live Link target so animation scrubbed in a DCC such as Maya streams into Unreal, including subject name matching and custom Animation Blueprints with the Live Link Pose node.
gotchas: Beta feature
Connection must be re-established if either application restarts or the file is reopened
Live Link Subject Name must match the DCC Object Name

summary: Reference for prim operations in the USD Stage Editor: the three Duplicate modes, cut/copy/paste via a clipboard stage, Add Reference and Add Payload dialogs with time code offset/scale, and isolating layers.
gotchas: Single Layer Specs only available when the current Edit Target has specs for the prim

summary: Hub page listing which asset types are made in-editor versus externally and linking to content pipeline guides: Artist Quick Start, Alembic, FBX, hair, Interchange, Skeletal/Static Meshes, Mutable, Datasmith, glTF, USD, LiDAR, MaterialX, modeling/Geometry Scripting, Variants, SpeedTree, Localization.

How to layer a high-tiling detail diffuse and normal over base textures, either with the DetailTexturing Material Function (requiring Texture Objects) or built manually, plus a distance-based blend between two textures using camera distance.
gotchas: DetailDiffuse and DetailNormal inputs only accept Texture Objects
Adds two or more texture lookups, which can cost performance and memory, especially on mobile

summary: How to create, edit, publish (Expose to Library, description, Library Categories) and use Material Functions, via the Palette, right-click search, or an Unspecified Function node.
keys: Use Selected Asset from Content Browser
gotchas: Saved edits propagate to every material using the function; duplicate it if unsure
Must click Apply to propagate changes
User functions go in the Misc category by default

summary: Step-by-step guide to building a parameterized parent Material (Scalar/Vector parameters, Convert to Parameter, slider ranges), creating and editing Material Instances, organizing parameters with groups and sort priority, and changing an instance's parent.
gotchas: Only parameter nodes are editable in instances; not every node can be parameterized
Changing the parent can remove the parameters the instance used

summary: Guidelines for a realistic skin Material based on the Content Examples skin map: base color, roughness (~0.4 with custom mips), specular 0.35, normal/detail normal blending with BlendAngleCorrectedNormals, opacity as SSS mask, tiling pores with Fresnel fade, and assigning a Subsurface Profile.
gotchas: Normal maps with inverted green channel must be fixed
Disable editor eye adaptation for controlled evaluation
Texture streaming ignores editor FOV zoom and may blur textures

summary: Tutorial building chrome and snow layers as Material Functions with Make Material Attributes, then blending them in a Material with Use Material Attributes, MatLayerBlend_Simple and WorldAlignedBlend so snow stays on upward faces, exposed via instance parameters.
Explains how Roughness, Metallic and Specular control reflectivity, then builds a parameterized material instance demonstrating gold metal and scuffed plastic looks.
gotchas: Leave Specular at 0.5 in most cases; it has no effect when Metallic is 1
Avoid Roughness of exactly 0 or 1
Many metallic surfaces reflecting each other can be expensive

summary: Explains the screen-space Subsurface Profile shading model for skin/wax: creating Subsurface Profile assets, enabling Burley, input channel behavior (Metallic unavailable, Opacity masks SSS), full-resolution vs checkerboard skin shading, console variables and the profile property reference.
gotchas: Metallic input is unavailable (GBuffer space repurposed)
Burley requires Temporal Anti-Aliasing
Full-resolution skin needs a 64-bit scene color format (FloatRGBA); falls back to checkerboard otherwise
Does not work on mobile (non-deferred); max 255 active profiles per scene

summary: How to make translucent materials (e.g. stained glass) cast colored shadows using baked Lightmass with Static lights, including disabling Lumen GI via a Post Process Volume, material blend/shading settings, lightmap resolution for sharpness, and the Path Tracer variant with Thin Translucent.
gotchas: Not supported by Lumen Global Illumination or Hardware Ray Tracing
Only Static-mobility lights cast colored translucent shadows (Lightmass)
Path Tracer requires Thin Translucent shading model
Modulate blend mode requires disabling Mobile Separate Translucency

summary: Shows how to enable Clear Coat Enable Second Normal and build a carbon fiber Clear Coat material with a separate normal map for the under-layer via the ClearCoatBottomNormal custom output.
gotchas: Requires the project setting and an editor restart
The second normal is only visible if wired into the ClearCoatBottomNormal node

summary: Explains the Fresnel expression (view-angle falloff) and the Fresnel_Function, with steps for a rim-light material, using normal maps with Fresnel (TransformVector to world space) for effects like an energy shield, and using Fresnel as a Lerp alpha.
gotchas: Normal maps fed to Fresnel's Normal input must be transformed from Tangent to World space
BaseReflectFractionIn of 1 effectively disables Fresnel

summary: How to fake rotational blur on fast-spinning objects like wheels using the Content Examples M_RadialMotionBlur material on a dummy hull mesh, with r.CustomDepth=3 and custom depth stencil setup, tuned via Angle and RimRadius.
gotchas: Requires assets from the Content Examples project (migrate them)
Dummy mesh must tightly cover the swept volume without intersecting the base mesh
Edit DefaultEngine.ini with the editor closed

summary: Tutorial for the Subsurface shading model: enabling it, a parameterized material with Subsurface Color and Opacity, a backlit test scene, and controlling scattering through Opacity, Subsurface Color value, and a texture mask.
gotchas: Opacity alone does not fully remove scattering; also darken Subsurface Color value

summary: How to make glowing materials with Emissive Color (values above 1 for bloom), choosing Unlit vs Default Lit, masked emissive with texture channels, emissive light propagation with Lumen, Use Emissive for Static Lighting with Lightmass, and taming bloom in a Post Process Volume.
gotchas: With Lumen, very small or very bright emissive sources cause noise
CPU Lightmass needs Use Emissive for Static Lighting per mesh; GPU Lightmass does not
Emissive must use Default Lit to illuminate surrounding objects

summary: Details how the Datasmith 3ds Max exporter translates geometry, instances, pivots, UV channels/lightmap UVs, custom collision, vertex colors, Forest Pack/RailClone (HISM), XRefs, lights, exposure, cameras, materials, procedural textures and metadata into Unreal.
gotchas: Instances with different pivots and non-uniform scale are unsupported; Reset XForm first
Custom LODs are not imported
Max 6 source UV channels preserved; two extra added for lightmaps
Lights are not instanced in Unreal

summary: How to sync a 3ds Max scene into Unreal using Datasmith Direct Link: Synchronize or Auto Sync to the cache, Datasmith > Direct Link Import in Unreal, and changing the cache directory.
gotchas: Requires the Datasmith Importer plugin
Importing before updating the cache shows an error

summary: Short guide to exporting a .udatasmith file from Archicad via the Datasmith palette's Export to Datasmith button.
How to install the VRED Datasmith exporter plugin script and export a VRED scene to FBX plus sidecar .lights, .var, .clips and .mats files for Datasmith import.
gotchas: Keep the sidecar files at the same relative path as the .FBX

summary: Exporting .udatasmith from Navisworks via the Unreal Datasmith ribbon tab (Merge level, Origin) or in bulk with a Python script using the Navisworks automation API.
How to use the Datasmith Dynamo node and sample script to batch export Revit 3D views to .udatasmith with chosen tessellation, filtered by view name prefix or instance parameter.
gotchas: Requires Dynamo 2.0 or higher

summary: Exporting .udatasmith files from Rhino via Save As, Export Selected, Export with Origin, or the Datasmith toolbar's Export 3D View button.
Exporting a SketchUp Pro scene to .udatasmith using the Datasmith toolbar Export button.
gotchas: Move the _Assets folder along with the .udatasmith file
